title: HERMES first light and the GALAH survey
what_was_studied: Four-channel multi-object design, commissioning and survey role
numerical_result: HERMES records about 400 fibres at resolving power near 28000, with a higher-resolution mode near 45000
remaining_question: Commissioning metrics do not establish precision-RV repeatability

title: The GALAH survey data reduction pipeline
what_was_studied: Reduction, extraction, cross-talk, scattered light and wavelength calibration
numerical_result: Reported fibre cross-talk is below about 0.5 percent and wavelength-solution accuracy is better than 1 km/s
remaining_question: How do fibre- and epoch-dependent wavelength errors propagate into released velocities?

title: The GALAH Survey accurate radial velocities and template library
what_was_studied: Template construction and survey radial velocities for GALAH DR2
numerical_result: Typical accuracy of 0.1 km/s was reported for 336215 stars
remaining_question: Survey-scale absolute accuracy is not metre-per-second planet-search precision

title: The GALAH+ Survey improved radial velocities
what_was_studied: Updated templates and comparison with Gaia DR2 and APOGEE DR16
numerical_result: Uncertainties were generally within 0.1 km/s and median external differences below 30 m/s for most groups
remaining_question: Population-dependent offsets and repeat-visit systematics remain to be separated

title: AAT current instruments
what_was_studied: Current facility roster and HERMES instrument role
numerical_result: HERMES is listed as a current fibre-fed high-resolution instrument with 392 science fibres
remaining_question: The roster does not provide a dated precision-RV performance floor
